topic: Data structure and session data analysis
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered technical requirements for integrating facility and tenant data, particularly concerning real-time sessions. It was determined that if separate sources exist for 'ch' (presumably a system) and 'af' (another system), the entire Joe&TheJuice (JCD) dataset must be added to the realtime sessions, preferably through a partner.

Regarding facility selection, [me] provided SQL queries to help [p1] select facilities belonging to specific tenants or parent IDs. The conversation concluded with an investigation into potential data duplication in session records around April 20th, which was dismissed after checking logs and system status.
decisions: The entire JCD dataset must be added to realtime sessions if separate sources for 'ch' and 'af' exist.
SQL queries were provided to assist in selecting facilities based on company/tenant IDs.
action_items: [p1] needs to implement a new firmware update to allow configuration loading with settings.
[me] needs to provide the SQL query for facility selection (already done).
